title: FILE REPORT - BUHONGWA / DATE : 2026
notes: Buhongwa Branch File report for 2026 (32 rows, January to September 2026), generated by the old Mikopofasta system. Imported as history: no loans, repayments, cash or ledger entries were created. Figures are as printed, including Daily, Weekly and Monthly loans, the statuses New/Active/Default/Done, loans from May 2026, and Collection/Paid amounts that include a fee. Every listed loan reconciles (its monthly payments equal its Paid Amount); the printed TOTAL row is larger than the sum of the listed rows (Jun +1,044,350, Jul +393,150, Aug +38,000), so it counts payments on loans the report does not list. Kept as printed. The report header prints the region as KIGOMA.
